authority.title: The JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) Data Interchange Format

equivalence_contract.nondeterministic_or_foreign_receivers: No duplicate-member, unpaired-surrogate or numeric-capability agreement beyond the explicit native comparison domain is claimed
equivalence_contract.parse_generate: For supported canonical IR, parse(generate(IR,preserve)) == IR with exact number spellings, pair order/duplicates and string codepoint lists
equivalence_contract.source_roundtrip: Parsing then generating preserves the chosen IR, not insignificant whitespace, escape spelling, original BOM or byte-for-byte source text
equivalence_contract.usl_materialization: Generated USL binds document to the same validated tagged IR under the exact USL runtime; native JSON has no program execution semantics

errata_policy.5318: Archived official snapshot changes unescaped solidus despite published raw-solidus allowance; retain raw solidus for this target and leave the alternate target unresolved
errata_policy.selected: Exact published text; no erratum silently patches the grammar

generator.domain: Validated canonical tagged IR; unknown tags, malformed shapes, invalid lexemes/codepoints and adjacent uncombined surrogate pairs are rejected
generator.duplicates_preserve_mode: explicit documented SHOULD exception for lossless data transport
generator.member_order: preserve representation order without promising object-order interoperability
generator.output: UTF-8 JSON bytes with mandatory escapes and no prefix BOM

not_defined_by_rfc8259.http_or_device_host: No server, protocol stack or real-device execution is supplied by this pure data API
not_defined_by_rfc8259.language_execution_library_threads_or_ab: RFC sections1,9,10 define data interchange and parse/generate operations, not a programming execution model, standard executable library, thread model or language ABI
not_defined_by_rfc8259.project_interfaces: Python/USL API boundaries and host runtime behavior still require project integration evidence; absence of RFC semantics does not auto-complete those gates

operation: Strict open-interchange UTF-8 JSON parsing, validated tagged-IR generation, and data-only USL literal materialization

parser.complete_input: exactly one ws value ws after optional initial BOM
parser.initial_bom: ignore one initial U+FEFF after UTF-8 decode
parser.input: UTF-8 bytes or Unicode text strictly UTF-8 encodable
parser.numbers: preserve exact JSON number lexeme, without floating-point arithmetic
parser.strings: decoded integer codepoint list; combine valid adjacent escaped surrogate pairs and preserve unmatched escaped surrogate values
